ops.title: Bound CCI lane-registration lookups without changing mesh compatibility
ops.description: First CCI0.41.1 carrier is installed and verified. Follow-on source proposal fundamental-efficiency/cci-physical-index-proposal.json targets Registered exact drive/lane EXISTS lookups using only two NONUNIQUE physical indexes outside unchanged logical migration literals, schema14, wire3 and fingerprint. Actual source shows sessions currently scans and records has drive-only alternatives. No live DDL authorized. Root requested source proposal and measured CI build/writer cost before activation; preserve all sessions and current read-only Open fast path.

ops.text: Independent source review approves the physical-index lifecycle without changing logical migration literals, schema14, wire3 or fingerprint
Actual old/new mixed Open and semantic tests pass; CI production lookup plan and honest comparison/VM counts demonstrate bounded scaling
